root: ^So let me get this straight. You are a magician named Gorgonzola, which is a type of cheese, and you are here trying to save your magic pet bunny named Pasghetti which is a common mispronunciation of "spaghetti"? Did you name your bunny after a food because you're also named after a food? Are you stupid and don't know how to say "spaghetti" correctly? He talks, doesn't he? Did he name himself instead? Did he name himself Pasghetti because he's a dumb animal that will never be smarter than a fifth grader? Why did your parents name you that? Did they even love you? Have you ever tried rabbit? I heard it tastes okay.
